To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the PRDX gene family of gilthead sea brean has been characterized, and the expression profiles in healthy and stressed animals have been described.

(1) the gilthead genome encodes six PRDX isoforms; (2) the PRDX gene family is phylogenetically conserved among fish; (3) PRDX genes show a tissue specific expression; (4) PRDXs are highly and constitutively expressed only in liver; (5) the head kidney is the most sensitive tissue in response to the different experimental stressors; (6) PRDXs can be considered as integrative biomarkers of fish welfare
